metadata.title: Global Mean Cloud Cover (ERA5 reanalysis, grid-sampled)
metadata.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API -- ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF / Copernicus C3S)
metadata.citation: Hersbach, H. et al. (2023). ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present. ECMWF/Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S). https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.adbb2d47 -- served via Open-Meteo.com (Zippenfenig, P., 2023, https://doi.org/10.5281/ZENODO.7970649)
metadata.method: 144-point Fibonacci-sphere equal-area global sample (land + ocean), ERA5 0.25° reanalysis, daily cloud_cover_mean averaged across points then across days in each month.

trend.basis: OLS fit of annual global cloud-cover anomaly (%) vs. year, complete years only
